accepted_plan.summary: Migrate `web/workspace` SvelteKit static SPA frontend tooling from npm/Node-primary to Deno-primary, including Deno config/tasks/lockfile, README/source-of-truth cleanup, generated artifact ignore/source-filter checks, and Deno check/build validation without changing backend authority.
accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates Deno/frontend/package hygiene, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
